hero.subtitle: Nextoken Capital connects you directly with asset issuers. Buy fractional shares of real estate, bonds, and energy projects — your wallet, your keys, your assets. We never touch your money.

services.categoryLead: Tokenized real-world assets across multiple categories. Verified, documented, and on-chain.
services.realEstateDesc: Commercial and residential property tokens. Earn rental income. From EUR 100.
services.bondsDesc: Government and corporate bonds on Polygon. Fixed schedules, transparent pricing.
services.energyDesc: Solar farms, wind energy. Green asset tokens with quarterly earnings.
services.commoditiesDesc: Tokenized exposure to gold, agriculture, and industrial resources.
services.equityDesc: Company equity as ERC-3643 tokens. Shareholder rights and distributions on-chain.
services.agricultureDesc: Farmland tokens. Seasonal earnings from crop production and land value.
services.step1Desc: MetaMask or WalletConnect. Your keys, your control.
services.step2Desc: Verify via Sumsub. One-time, takes 2 minutes.
services.step3Desc: Explore assets. Buy directly — funds go to issuer.
services.step4Desc: Quarterly earnings to your wallet. Track on-chain.

trust.title: Every Asset Passes 5-Step Verification
trust.lead: We do not list assets blindly. Every listing goes through rigorous verification before reaching the marketplace.
trust.nonCustodialDesc: Funds go directly from your wallet to the issuer via smart contract. Nextoken never holds your money.
trust.rightsDesc: Each ERC-3643 token represents legal economic rights to the underlying asset.
trust.ownershipDesc: Issuers retain legal ownership. Token holders own fractional economic rights.
trust.kycDesc: Licensed global KYC provider. Document checks, facial recognition, AML screening.
trust.onchainDesc: Every transaction on Polygon blockchain. Publicly verifiable. No hidden ledgers.
trust.paymentsDesc: EUR payments through Monerium — EU-licensed EMI. Bank-grade payment rails.
